comingLast.roast: finished on 18 - the bravest thing now is staying for the presentation
at 1.2 a hole he is on track for the full ceremony
the buffer reads 1 - his group reads it aloud each tee
sitting 1 above Elliott and driving very, very carefully
1 point of daylight - barely enough to read by
the escape ladder has 2 rungs - grip well
5 above Elliott and in - now it is all spectator sport with stakes
sitting 5 above Elliott and driving very, very carefully
safe-ish by 6 - the blue balls have come back from further
done, 6 clear, and suddenly an expert on everyone else's back nine
